name: Andriy Mulyar
bio: Andriy Mulyar is a co-founder of Nomic AI, founded in 2022, and an author of the 2023 GPT4All paper on locally runnable open language models. Nomic also released the open nomic-embed-text embedding models and the Atlas data visualization platform.
